title: Report Re M.J. Sladkovsky, Soviet Employee

page_data.en:
Form No. 1
G. 25,000-1-34

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S. B, Special Branch.
REPORT
Date January 15, 1935.
File No.
S. B. REGISTER.
No. 6006

Subject in full: M.J. Slackovsky, Soviet employee.

Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky. Forwarded by (Signature) D.C.

Mihail Josiphovitch Slackovsky, Soviet citizen,
employee of the Centrosojus (England) Ltd., arrived in Shanghai
from Moscow via Dairen on January 12, 1935 by the s.s. Tsingtao
Maru. He is a Russian who was born in 1906. He holds
Soviet passport No. 22035 issued on 20.9.34 which bears a
Chinese visa issued at Moscow.
His address has not yet been located.

(Signature) g. tcheremshansky
D. S.

D. C. (Special Branch).

File
MS
